description: Information technology distributor and solutions aggregator for PCs, data center, cloud, and artificial intelligence infrastructure.

catalyst.facts_line: 2026-09-24 (Thursday, before the open), 5 days out -- from the earnings calendar, consensus EPS 4.68.
catalyst.why: It must show another EPS beat and raised guidance, confirming AI infrastructure demand is still accelerating and not yet priced.

reasons: European IT distribution revenue is forecast to grow 7.5% in 2026, the fastest since the pandemic, directly lifting SNX's top line while the market worries about cloud migration.
IT buyers now expect 2026 budgets to grow 5.8% year-over-year, up from 3.6% two quarters earlier, so SNX's distribution revenue has more runway than the 13.95x forward price-to-earnings implies.

AI/ML [artificial intelligence/machine learning] is the only category where more buyers plan to expand suppliers than consolidate, so SNX's vendor and customer base grows even as cloud migration pressures legacy hardware.
